name: Optmyzr MCP
description: Optmyzr helps advertisers and agencies inspect linked ad-account performance, opportunities, analytics, alerts, and workspace data; find product guidance; create monitoring routines; and apply reviewable changes from Claude with human oversight.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Optmyzr MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Optmyzr MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://tools.optmyzr.com/OptmyzrMcp.svc. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Optmyzr MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Optmyzr MCP provides these MCP tools: create_routine, describe_capability, get_platform_data, get_routine_data, get_workspace_data, make_changes, and search_optmyzr_knowledge.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Optmyzr MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Optmyzr MCP in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.

_published_faq.name: Does Optmyzr MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Optmyzr MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Optmyzr MCP is developed by Optmyzr Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
